mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.region, c.address, c.contact_email AS contactEmail, c.contact_phone AS contactPhone, c.type, c.business_number AS businessNumber, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, COALESCE(rm.avg_rating, 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(rm.cnt, 0) AS reviewCount FROM companies c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT reviewed_company_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM company_reviews GROUP BY reviewed_company_id ) rm ON rm.reviewed_company_id = c.id
ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.region, c.address, c.contact_email AS contactEmail, c.contact_phone AS contactPhone, c.type, c.business_number AS businessNumber, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, COALESCE(rm.avg_rating, 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(rm.cnt, 0) AS reviewCount FROM companies c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT reviewed_company_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM company_reviews GROUP BY reviewed_company_id ) rm ON rm.reviewed_company_id = c.id
ORDER BY COALESCE(rm.avg_rating, 0) DESC, COALESCE(rm.cnt, 0) DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, name, region, address, contact_email AS contactEmail, contact_phone AS contactPhone, type, business_number AS businessNumber, external_source AS externalSource, external_key AS externalKey, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM companies WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO companies (name, region, address, contact_email, contact_phone, type, external_source, external_key) VALUES ( #{name}, #{region}, #{address}, #{contactEmail}, #{contactPhone}, #{type}, #{externalSource}, #{externalKey} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), address = VALUES(address), contact_phone = VALUES(contact_phone), type = VALUES(type), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
